name: Schaumburg Specialties - Racks & Carts
old_description: From industrial bakeries and donut CMLs to airline catering commissaries and prepared meal facilities, SHOPCraft delivers high-performance oven racks, bakery carts, processing tables, and dough troughs that keep your production line running smoothly.
about:
Schaumburg Specialties operates from Schaumburg, Illinois, producing custom metal racks and carts for food production and industrial applications. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founder names.

The company manufactures oven racks, bakery carts, processing tables, dough troughs, donut racks, speed racks, pan racks, lug racks, sheet pans, wire screens, and nesting racks under the SHOPCraft, KWIKCraft, and AGRICraft product lines. Its capabilities include custom metal fabrication, welded construction, design and engineering, bulk product development, and maintenance and equipment servicing. All products are built using all-welded construction with top-of-the-line materials such as 18-gauge aluminum and stainless steel, and carry a lifetime guarantee.

Schaumburg Specialties serves industrial bakeries, donut production lines, airline catering commissaries, prepared meal facilities, meat and seafood processors, pet food manufacturers, and agriculture and indoor farming operations. Customer references include David's Burgers, Bimbo, Udi's (Pinnacle Foods), Illinois State University, Carolina CPL Co-Op, and businesses in Appleton, WI; Elk Grove, IL; and Chapel Hill, NC.

The company emphasizes American-made, tariff-free production and positions its welded, low-maintenance designs as a durability differentiator. It highlights NSF-certified donut basket racks and anodized coatings as premium features that justify higher upfront cost over cheaper alternatives.
